The approval is based on the HERCULES phase 3 study demonstrating significant delay in disability progression. However, the drug carries identified safety risks including drug-induced liver injury, requiring strict liver monitoring.

ENVMY.title: Holding(s) in Company
ENVMY.summary: Van Eck Associates Corporation, through its various ETFs, has reduced its voting rights in Endeavour Mining PLC from 7.995% to 6.947% as of June 19, 2026. GIW.title: SEALSQ and WISeKey Establish Quantisimo Corp. as a Special Purpose Vehicle, and Execute Letter of Intent with GigCapital8 Corp.
GIW.summary: SEALSQ and WISeKey have created Quantisimo Corp., a special purpose vehicle designed to be a Trusted Quantum Pure-Play platform. HCM.title: HUTCHMED Highlights Pivotal Phase II Data for Fanregratinib in Intrahepatic Cholangiocarcinoma Presented at ESMO Gastrointestinal Cancers Congress 2026

EQS.summary: Activist shareholder Howard Todd Horberg, holding 5.61% of Equus Total Return, Inc. (NYSE: EQS), has filed a Schedule 13D challenging the board's stewardship. Horberg calls for suspension of automatic salary escalators, an independent compensation review, and a strategic review including potential merger or acquisition to address the company's concentrated portfolio and excessive overhead.

BIIB.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating Biogen Inc. for potential securities fraud following the company's announcement of Phase 2 CELIA study results for diranersen (BIIB080), an Alzheimer's disease treatment. INTU.summary: Pomerantz LLP is investigating Intuit for potential securities fraud following the company's May 20, 2026 announcement of disappointing fiscal Q3 2026 results. DXLG.title: Destination XL Group, Inc. to Review Revised, Unsolicited Tender Offer From Zodiac Partners II
DXLG.summary: Destination XL Group's Board announced it is evaluating a revised unsolicited tender offer from Zodiac Partners II, LLC to acquire all outstanding shares at $0.84 per share, a slight increase from the previously rejected $0.82 offer on May 26, 2026. ELBM.title: Electra Announces Voting Results from 2026 Annual Meeting of Shareholders
ELBM.summary: Electra Battery Materials Corporation held its 2026 annual general and special meeting on June 23, 2026, with shareholders approving all items of business including the election of seven directors and amendments to the Long-Term Incentive Plan and Employee Share Purchase Plan. The company also received shareholder authorization for a potential reverse stock split at a ratio between 1:2 and 1:6, though implementation remains at the board's discretion.

ONEQ.summary: As markets anticipate potential Federal Reserve rate cuts in the second half of 2026, risk assets including equities and cryptocurrencies have rallied. LKQ.title: LKQ ALERT: Bragar Eagel & Squire, P.C. is Investigating LKQ Corporation on Behalf of Long-Term Stockholders and Encourages Investors to Contact the Firm

The complaint alleges that LKQ made false statements about the acquisition's benefits while concealing that FinishMaster was losing major customers and market share. PBH.title: Prestige Consumer Healthcare Inc. (PBH) Clear Eyes® and Pillar5 Problems Drive Stock Lower, Hagens Berman Investigating

The facility, which was supposed to resolve Clear Eyes supply chain constraints, failed to deliver expected results. WORX.title: SCWorx Receives Nasdaq Hearings Panel Decision Granting the Company’s Request to Continue its Listing on the Nasdaq Stock Market, Subject to Compliance Conditions

The company must obtain shareholder approval for a reverse stock split by July 22, 2026, execute the split by August 3, 2026, and demonstrate compliance with the bid price rule by August 28, 2026. Failure to meet these conditions will result in delisting to OTC Markets.

BITA.title: Hypersurface Acquires Acre to Launch the First On-Chain Bitcoin Premium Income Vault

The product will be managed by Monarq Asset Management and allows Bitcoin holders to deposit BTC directly and earn returns without converting to traditional financial products, competing with similar offerings like BlackRock's BITA and Yieldmax's MSTY.

FTS.title: Muskrat Dam First Nation Energized by Wataynikaneyap Power
FTS.summary: Wataynikaneyap Power announced the energization of Muskrat Dam First Nation on April 9, 2026, connecting the remote Ontario community to the provincial power grid and eliminating its reliance on diesel generators. This marks the 16th community connected under the project, which is majority-owned by 24 First Nations in partnership with Fortis Inc. The grid connection enables the community to redirect diesel transportation costs toward infrastructure development and growth initiatives.

LUCN.title: **1999 Called. It Wants Its Bubble Back.
LUCN.summary: Financial researcher Jim Rickards draws parallels between today's AI boom and the late 1990s dot-com bubble, warning that circular financing structures and inflated valuations may not reflect actual profitability. He highlights July 29th earnings cycle as a potential moment when AI sector expectations could collide with financial reality, similar to the Nasdaq's 77% decline in 2000.

QMMM.title: QMMM Announces Receipt of Delisting Notice from Nasdaq
QMMM.summary: QMMM Holdings Limited (NASDAQ: QMMM), a Hong Kong-based digital media advertising and virtual technology company, announced on June 23, 2026 that it received a Staff Delisting Determination from Nasdaq on June 17, 2026. The delisting is due to the company's failure to file its Form 20-F for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2025. The company plans to appeal the determination by requesting an oral hearing before the Nasdaq Hearings Panel and will submit a written compliance plan, though there is no assurance the panel will approve the request.

CHRS.title: Coherus and Zumutor Biologics Announce Clinical Collaboration to Evaluate ZM008 in Combination with LOQTORZI® (toripalimab-tpzi)
CHRS.summary: Coherus Oncology and Zumutor Biologics announced a Phase 1 clinical collaboration to evaluate ZM008, an anti-LLT1 monoclonal antibody, in combination with LOQTORZI (toripalimab-tpzi), a PD-1 inhibitor, in patients with various solid tumors. The trial will enroll up to 45 patients and aims to evaluate safety, tolerability, and identify biomarkers for personalized therapies. Both companies retain commercial rights to their respective compounds.

EBIT.title: EARNED Signs 2026 MLB Draft Prospect and Tennessee Commit Cody Boshell
EBIT.summary: EARNED, a baseball culture brand founded by youth players, announced the signing of Cody Boshell, a top 2026 MLB Draft prospect and University of Tennessee commit, as a brand ambassador. Boshell, a 6-foot-3, 220-pound first baseman and left-handed pitcher from Florida, joins EARNED's growing roster of professional and elite amateur athletes. The partnership aligns with EARNED's mission to celebrate hard work, discipline, and earning opportunities in baseball.
